search_scope: Native Current Markdown in immediate role directories under Core Meta Model and Project Configuration; excludes archive, drafts, generated/evidence copies, actual Workflow instances.

references.text: an Implementation Method qualified under CA-R-1767 **must** receive its numeric Tier from its complete Claim and current Scope Unit under CA-M-438; reusability alone **must not** force a particular Tier. Tier admission **must not** impose a Content-Role or Type-to-Tier restriction.

matches.disposition: Amend same Summary or successor if meaning altered: remove retired R1767 qualification and child_of; preserve Tier derived from complete Claim and Scope, reusability does not fix Tier, no Role/Form-to-Tier restriction; bind genuine replacement only if actually supported.
Existing candidate still carries child_of R1767; remove/rebind only to genuinely applicable replacement, retain R037 if valid and preserve independent Decision.
Existing candidate still carries child_of R1767; remove/rebind only to genuinely applicable replacement, retain R030 if valid and preserve conditional terminal permission.

references.text: **every** parent Scope Unit **must** own the Goal Atoms for its immediate child Scope Units under CA-R-926; those Goal Atoms belong **to** the parent's Owned Atoms **and** the child's Targeting Atoms **without** transferring their ownership.

matches.disposition: Retire direct-child Goal ownership rule; new external delegation authority can preserve delegator accountability without silently claiming Goal. Summary identity requires new ID for materially changed rule.

Direct conflict beyond metadata: Goal target direct child or Project; Project-only Goal requires revised Project binding, no separate target field. Preserve no independent structural changes. Remove stale unversioned child_of R926 only via supported authority.

references.text: Release Definition and Environment Definition remain outside PROGRAMMATIC and its declared descendants under CA-R-1665; CA-R-2123 governs the Method and Delivery Type restriction in that scope.

matches.disposition: Amend Delivery Form token and admission references after new Form authority is settled; preserve Delivery filename encoding and other still-admitted specialized Forms, do not invent runtime behavior.

references.text: Within PROGRAMMATIC and its declared descendants, Current Method and Delivery Atoms use only Eng Policy or Eng Decision under CA-R-2123; legacy Implementation Method and Implementation Decision names are not additional admitted values there. Existing specialized values remain governed by their own definitions outside that scope.

matches.disposition: Existing proposed candidate must remove R2123 reference; check merged preview and applicable serialization authority.

matches.disposition: Retire obsolete Eng Decision Form definition and reference to old R2123/R1767 when Decision Form authority replaces it. Preserve bounded concrete choice and no Form-to-Tier restriction in replacement where applicable; Summary identity requires new ID if changed.

cautions: Versioned frozen references, if any, are historical and must not be mechanically rewritten.
